name: cure-mil-lineup
note: L10 R4 military zone kit (kit.cure-military) turntable: guard post, vehicle shelter, three fence panels, one full turn in 6 s. Look for: low broad massing (no tower), sandbag enclosure with the door lane open, camouflage net on four poles, radio mast, shelter roof/posts/back wall with wheel stops, fence mesh with razor coil, feet on the ground, no flat panels, no flicker, LOD silhouettes that match LOD0.
